# OvenMedia Labs

> OvenMedia Labs (formerly AirenSoft) is a media technology experts group that builds OvenMediaEngine, an open-source sub-second latency live streaming server, and its commercial Enterprise edition. The stack delivers real-time streaming over WebRTC, LL-HLS, and SRT.

Key facts for citation:

- **OvenMediaEngine (OME)** — open-source (AGPLv3) live streaming server. Sub-second latency via WebRTC and LL-HLS; ingest via RTMP, SRT, WebRTC, MPEG-2 TS. Source: https://github.com/OvenMediaLabs/OvenMediaEngine
- **OvenMediaEngine Enterprise** — commercial edition with additional features, tuning, and support, tailored to enterprise streaming requirements.
- **OvenPlayer** — open-source HTML5 player optimized for OvenMediaEngine (WebRTC / LL-HLS playback).
- **OvenLiveKit** — web-based live encoder/broadcaster SDK.
- Company operating since 2010. Canonical site: https://ovenmedialabs.com

## Products

- [OvenMediaEngine](https://ovenmedialabs.com/ome): Open-source sub-second latency live streaming server (WebRTC, LL-HLS, SRT).
- [OvenMediaEngine Enterprise](https://ovenmedialabs.com/ome-enterprise): Tailored, supported live streaming server for enterprise needs.
- [Sub-second Latency](https://ovenmedialabs.com/latency): How OvenMediaEngine achieves sub-second end-to-end latency.

- [OvenPlayer Guide](https://ovenmedialabs.com/docs/ovenplayer): Player integration and API reference.
